verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API, an MCP integration, and an interactive try-it reference, but nothing in the evidence describes a sandbox or test environment isolated from production data. The try-it dashboard uses a real `cap-api-…` token against the live API. Creating a separate space, AI approval of proposed edits (a dry-run-like review, not sandbox isolation), and version-history restore are user workarounds or adjacent controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
